label: RHONE-4412 introduces the statements endpoint (vulnerable)

findings.title: Authorization bypass for account statements
findings.rationale: The method allows any authenticated customer to view statements for accounts they don't own, violating the principle of least privilege. The ownership check only logs a warning and returns success.
findings.exploit: An attacker could access other users' financial data by manipulating account IDs
